name: protocol_by_quarter
caption: Block fill and stop-token rate by quarter of each trajectory, then averaged across trajectories of the same generator with a 95% bootstrap CI. Quarters are even bins over steps, not tokens: fill and stop are per-request properties, and late steps shorten when the model starts hitting stop.
alt_text: Block fill and stop-token rate by quarter of each trajectory, then averaged across trajectories of the same generator with a 95% bootstrap CI. Quarters are even bins over steps, not tokens: fill and stop are per-request properties, and late steps shorten when the model starts hitting stop.
limitations: A run-level mean is not shown and must not be read off the figure. Drift inside a quarter is hidden. This is a protocol diagnostic, not a semantic measurement: a falling fill does not by itself mean the trajectory has reached a semantic fixed point.
